note: Graph of the 30 pre-Brock maps joined by warps (concrete tiles both ends) and overworld connections (direction+offset; C2 resolves exact border tiles at execution time from live map dimensions). Nodes are per CONNECTED COMPONENT, not per map: a map bisected by an impassable line (Route 2's Cut-tree wall, Pewter Museum's ticket gate) gets one node per 4-connected passable region, and every edge carries `from.component`/`to.component` so BFS can re-enter the same map at a different region (the Pallet -> Pewter detour through Viridian Forest). Component indices match components.json 1:1. `boundaryEdges` are real warps/connections whose destination falls outside the pre-Brock extraction scope (e.g. Route 1 -> Route 21, Pewter City -> Route 3) — kept so consumers see a documented scope wall rather than an edge that silently vanished.
